_comment: two example rows in the register's shape; replace with your own and keep the lint in pre-commit

lessons.lesson: Never let a retention job delete an older artefact until the newest one is proven to come from a completed run (a completion sentinel or manifest gate) — retention that keeps the newest-named directory is one failed run from zero backups.
lessons.applies_when: designing or reviewing any prune / retention / rotation step

enforcement.where: the prune script's manifest gate (it refuses to delete until the newest run's completion sentinel exists) + a quarterly restore drill in the runbook

lessons.lesson: Fixed-schema batch extraction (any many-call JSON job) runs on the cheapest model tier that passes its own grader — never a flagship tier by default; chunk small, disable tools when the prompt inlines the text, checkpoint per batch so a model switch loses nothing.
lessons.applies_when: any headless many-call job before its model is chosen

enforcement.where: the batch runner's defaults (model, chunk size, tools off)
